summary: Security Event Tokens can describe events about many kinds of subjects. This document defines Subject Identifiers as structured JSON objects with named formats. It also creates a registry of such formats, and a JWT "sub_id" claim.

eli5.summary: When reporting an incident, you need to say who it's about, with a name, an email, or a number. This sets up shared name tags so everyone writes them the same way.

questions: subject identifiers for security event tokens
